statement: ∀ (m n : ℕ) (hmn : m ≥ n) (hn : n ≥ 3), IsLeast { k : ℕ | 0 < k ∧ ∀ c : ℕ → Bool, (∃ x : Fin m → ℕ, (∀ i : Fin m, 1 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ k ∧ c (x i) = true) ∧ (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin m => i.val < m - 1)).sum (fun i => x i) < x ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩) ∨ (∃ y : Fin n → ℕ, (∀ i : Fin n, 1 ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ k ∧ c (y i) = false) ∧ (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => i.val < n - 1)).sum (fun i => y i) < y ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩) } ((m - 1) * n + 1)
proofTerm:
by
  classical
  intro m n hmn hn
  let K : ℕ := (m - 1) * n + 1
  have hm_ge3 : 3 ≤ m := le_trans hn hmn
  have hn_pos : 0 < n := by omega
  have hm_pos : 0 < m := by omega
  have hK_pos : 0 < K := by
    dsimp [K]
    exact Nat.succ_pos ((m - 1) * n)
  have hm1_ge1 : 1 ≤ m - 1 := by omega
  have hm1_ge2 : 2 ≤ m - 1 := by omega
  have hK_ge_n : n ≤ K := by
    dsimp [K]
    calc
      n = 1 * n := by rw [one_mul]
      _ ≤ (m - 1) * n := Nat.mul_le_mul_right n hm1_ge1
      _ ≤ (m - 1) * n + 1 := Nat.le_succ _
  have hK_ge_m : m ≤ K := by
    dsimp [K]
    calc
      m = (m - 1) + 1 := by omega
      _ ≤ (m - 1) * 3 := by
        have hge : 2 ≤ m - 1 := hm1_ge2
        nlinarith
      _ ≤ (m - 1) * n := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (m - 1) hn
      _ ≤ (m - 1) * n + 1 := Nat.le_succ _
  have hcard_first : ∀ N : ℕ, 0 < N →
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin N => i.val < N - 1)).card = N - 1 := by
    intro N hN
    let last : Fin N := ⟨N - 1, by omega⟩
    have hfilter : (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin N => i.val < N - 1)) = Finset.univ.erase last := by
      ext i
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_erase, ne_eq]
      constructor
      · intro hi
        constructor
        · intro hEq
          have hval : i.val = N - 1 := by
            have := congrArg Fin.val hEq
            simpa [last] using this
          omega
        · trivial
      · intro hne
        have hne' : i ≠ last := hne.1
        by_contra hnot
        have hge : N - 1 ≤ i.val := le_of_not_gt hnot
        have hlt : i.val < N := i.isLt
        have hval : i.val = N - 1 := by omega
        apply hne'
        ext
        simp [last, hval]
    calc
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin N => i.val < N - 1)).card
          = (Finset.univ.erase last).card := by rw [hfilter]
      _ = (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N)).card - 1 := by
        rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem (by simp : last ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N)))]
      _ = N - 1 := by simp
  have hsum_const_first : ∀ (N C : ℕ), 0 < N →
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin N => i.val < N - 1)).sum (fun _ : Fin N => C) =
        (N - 1) * C := by
    intro N C hN
    rw [Finset.sum_const, hcard_first N hN]
    simp
  let c0 : ℕ → Bool := fun z => if z < n then false else true
  have source_step_0 :
      ¬ ((∃ x : Fin m → ℕ,
            (∀ i : Fin m, 1 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ (m - 1) * n ∧ c0 (x i) = true) ∧
            (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin m => i.val < m - 1)).sum (fun i => x i) <
              x ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩)
         ∨ (∃ y : Fin n → ℕ,
            (∀ i : Fin n, 1 ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ (m - 1) * n ∧ c0 (y i) = false) ∧
            (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => i.val < n - 1)).sum (fun i => y i) <
              y ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩)) := by
    rintro (⟨x, hx, hxlt⟩ | ⟨y, hy, hylt⟩)
    · have hx_ge : ∀ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin m => i.val < m - 1), n ≤ x i := by
        intro i hi
        have htrue : c0 (x i) = true := (hx i).2.2
        dsimp [c0] at htrue
        by_cases hxi : x i < n
        · simp [hxi] at htrue
        · omega
      have hsum_ge : (m - 1) * n ≤
          (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin m => i.val < m - 1)).sum (fun i => x i) := by
        calc
          (m - 1) * n =
              (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin m => i.val < m - 1)).sum (fun _ : Fin m => n) := by
                rw [hsum_const_first m n (by omega)]
          _ ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin m => i.val < m - 1)).sum (fun i => x i) := by
                apply Finset.sum_le_sum
                intro i hi
                exact hx_ge i hi
      have hlast_le : x ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩ ≤ (m - 1) * n := (hx ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩).2.1
      have : (m - 1) * n < x ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩ := lt_of_le_of_lt hsum_ge hxlt
      omega
    · have hy_lt : ∀ i : Fin n, c0 (y i) = false → y i < n := by
        intro i hfalse
        dsimp [c0] at hfalse
        by_cases hi : y i < n
        · exact hi
        · simp [hi] at hfalse
      have hy_ge_one : ∀ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => i.val < n - 1), 1 ≤ y i := by
        intro i hi
        exact (hy i).1
      have hsum_ge : n - 1 ≤
          (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => i.val < n - 1)).sum (fun i => y i) := by
        calc
          n - 1 = (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => i.val < n - 1)).sum (fun _ : Fin n => 1) := by
            rw [hsum_const_first n 1 (by omega)]
            simp
          _ ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => i.val < n - 1)).sum (fun i => y i) := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum
            intro i hi
            exact hy_ge_one i hi
      have hylast_lt : y ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩ < n := by
        apply hy_lt ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
        exact (hy ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩).2.2
      have hylast_le : y ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩ ≤ n - 1 := by omega
      have : n - 1 < y ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩ := lt_of_le_of_lt hsum_ge hylt
      omega
  have source_step_1 : ∀ c : ℕ → Bool, c 1 = false ∨ c 1 = true := by
    intro c
    cases c 1 <;> simp
  have source_step_2 :
      ∀ c : ℕ → Bool, c 1 = false →
        ((∃ x : Fin m → ℕ,
            (∀ i : Fin m, 1 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ K ∧ c (x i) = true) ∧
            (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin m => i.val < m - 1)).sum (fun i => x i) <
              x ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩)
         ∨ (∃ y : Fin n → ℕ,
            (∀ i : Fin n, 1 ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ K ∧ c (y i) = false) ∧
            (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => i.val < n - 1)).sum (fun i => y i) <
              y ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩)) := by
    intro c hc1
    by_cases hb : ∃ b : ℕ, n ≤ b ∧ b ≤ K ∧ c b = false
    · rcases hb with ⟨b, hbn, hbK, hbc⟩
      right
      let y : Fin n → ℕ := fun i => if (i : ℕ) < n - 1 then 1 else b
      refine ⟨y, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro i
        by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) < n - 1
        · refine ⟨by simp [y, hi], ?_, ?_⟩
          · simp [y, hi]
            omega
          · simpa [y, hi] using hc1
        · have hival : (i : ℕ) = n - 1 := by
            have hlt : (i : ℕ) < n := i.isLt
            have hge : n - 1 ≤ (i : ℕ) := le_of_not_gt hi
            omega
          have hb1 : 1 ≤ b := by omega
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · simp [y, hi, hb1]
          · simpa [y, hi] using hbK
          · simpa [y, hi] using hbc
      · have hsum : (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => i.val < n - 1)).sum (fun i => y i) = n - 1 := by
          calc
            (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => i.val < n - 1)).sum (fun i => y i)
                = (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => i.val < n - 1)).sum (fun _ : Fin n => 1) := by
                  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
                  intro i hi
                  have hi' : (i : ℕ) < n - 1 := by
                    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
                  simp [y, hi']
            _ = n - 1 := by
                  rw [hsum_const_first n 1 (by omega)]
                  simp
        have hlast : y ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩ = b := by
          simp [y]
        rw [hsum, hlast]
        omega
    · left
      have hred_of_not_blue : ∀ a : ℕ, n ≤ a → a ≤ K → c a = true := by
        intro a han haK
        cases hca : c a
        · exfalso
          exact hb ⟨a, han, haK, hca⟩
        · rfl
      let x : Fin m → ℕ := fun i => if (i : ℕ) < m - 1 then n else K
      refine ⟨x, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro i
        by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) < m - 1
        · have hcn : c n = true := hred_of_not_blue n le_rfl hK_ge_n
          have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := by omega
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · simp [x, hi, hn1]
          · simpa [x, hi] using hK_ge_n
          · simpa [x, hi] using hcn
        · have hival : (i : ℕ) = m - 1 := by
            have hlt : (i : ℕ) < m := i.isLt
            have hge : m - 1 ≤ (i : ℕ) := le_of_not_gt hi
            omega
          have hcK : c K = true := hred_of_not_blue K hK_ge_n le_rfl
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · simp [x, hi]
            omega
          · simp [x, hi]
          · simpa [x, hi] using hcK
      · have hsum : (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin m => i.val < m - 1)).sum (fun i => x i) = (m - 1) * n := by
          calc
            (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin m => i.val < m - 1)).sum (fun i => x i)
                = (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin m => i.val < m - 1)).sum (fun _ : Fin m => n) := by
                  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
                  intro i hi
                  have hi' : (i : ℕ) < m - 1 := by
                    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
                  simp [x, hi']
            _ = (m - 1) * n := by
                  exact hsum_const_first m n (by omega)
        have hlast : x ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩ = K := by
          simp [x]
        rw [hsum, hlast]
        dsimp [K]
        exact Nat.lt_succ_self ((m - 1) * n)
  have source_step_3 :
      ∀ c : ℕ → Bool, c 1 = true →
        ((∃ x : Fin m → ℕ,
            (∀ i : Fin m, 1 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ K ∧ c (x i) = true) ∧
            (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin m => i.val < m - 1)).sum (fun i => x i) <
              x ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩)
         ∨ (∃ y : Fin n → ℕ,
            (∀ i : Fin n, 1 ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ K ∧ c (y i) = false) ∧
            (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => i.val < n - 1)).sum (fun i => y i) <
              y ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩)) := by
    intro c hc1
    by_cases ha : ∃ a : ℕ, m ≤ a ∧ a ≤ K ∧ c a = true
    · rcases ha with ⟨a, ham, haK, hac⟩
      left
      let x : Fin m → ℕ := fun i => if (i : ℕ) < m - 1 then 1 else a
      refine ⟨x, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro i
        by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) < m - 1
        · refine ⟨by simp [x, hi], ?_, ?_⟩
          · simp [x, hi]
            omega
          · simpa [x, hi] using hc1
        · have hival : (i : ℕ) = m - 1 := by
            have hlt : (i : ℕ) < m := i.isLt
            have hge : m - 1 ≤ (i : ℕ) := le_of_not_gt hi
            omega
          have ha1 : 1 ≤ a := by omega
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · simp [x, hi, ha1]
          · simpa [x, hi] using haK
          · simpa [x, hi] using hac
      · have hsum : (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin m => i.val < m - 1)).sum (fun i => x i) = m - 1 := by
          calc
            (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin m => i.val < m - 1)).sum (fun i => x i)
                = (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin m => i.val < m - 1)).sum (fun _ : Fin m => 1) := by
                  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
                  intro i hi
                  have hi' : (i : ℕ) < m - 1 := by
                    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
                  simp [x, hi']
            _ = m - 1 := by
                  rw [hsum_const_first m 1 (by omega)]
                  simp
        have hlast : x ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩ = a := by
          simp [x]
        rw [hsum, hlast]
        have : m - 1 < a := by omega
        exact this
    · right
      let T : ℕ := (n - 1) * m + 1
      have hT_gt_m : m < T := by
        dsimp [T]
        have hle : m ≤ (n - 1) * m := by
          calc
            m = 1 * m := by rw [one_mul]
            _ ≤ (n - 1) * m := Nat.mul_le_mul_right m (by omega : 1 ≤ n - 1)
        omega
      have hT_le_K : T ≤ K := by
        dsimp [T, K]
        have hnm1 : n - 1 ≤ m - 1 := by omega
        have hm_eq : m = (m - 1) + 1 := by omega
        have hn_eq : n = (n - 1) + 1 := by omega
        calc
          (n - 1) * m + 1
              = (n - 1) * ((m - 1) + 1) + 1 := by
                  conv_lhs => rw [hm_eq]
          _ = (n - 1) * (m - 1) + (n - 1) + 1 := by
                  rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one]
          _ ≤ (n - 1) * (m - 1) + (m - 1) + 1 := by
                  omega
          _ = (m - 1) * (n - 1) + (m - 1) + 1 := by
                  rw [Nat.mul_comm (n - 1) (m - 1)]
          _ = (m - 1) * ((n - 1) + 1) + 1 := by
                  rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one]
          _ = (m - 1) * n + 1 := by
                  conv_lhs => rw [← hn_eq]
      have hblue_of_not_red : ∀ b : ℕ, m ≤ b → b ≤ K → c b = false := by
        intro b hmb hbK
        cases hcb : c b
        · rfl
        · exfalso
          exact ha ⟨b, hmb, hbK, hcb⟩
      let y : Fin n → ℕ := fun i => if (i : ℕ) < n - 1 then m else T
      refine ⟨y, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro i
        by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) < n - 1
        · have hcm : c m = false := hblue_of_not_red m le_rfl hK_ge_m
          have hm1 : 1 ≤ m := by omega
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · simp [y, hi, hm1]
          · simpa [y, hi] using hK_ge_m
          · simpa [y, hi] using hcm
        · have hival : (i : ℕ) = n - 1 := by
            have hlt : (i : ℕ) < n := i.isLt
            have hge : n - 1 ≤ (i : ℕ) := le_of_not_gt hi
            omega
          have hcT : c T = false := hblue_of_not_red T (by omega) hT_le_K
          have hT1 : 1 ≤ T := by omega
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · simp [y, hi]
            exact hT1
          · simpa [y, hi] using hT_le_K
          · simpa [y, hi] using hcT
      · have hsum : (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => i.val < n - 1)).sum (fun i => y i) = (n - 1) * m := by
          calc
            (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => i.val < n - 1)).sum (fun i => y i)
                = (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => i.val < n - 1)).sum (fun _ : Fin n => m) := by
                  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
                  intro i hi
                  have hi' : (i : ℕ) < n - 1 := by
                    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
                  simp [y, hi']
            _ = (n - 1) * m := by
                  exact hsum_const_first n m (by omega)
        have hlast : y ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩ = T := by
          simp [y]
        rw [hsum, hlast]
        dsimp [T]
        exact Nat.lt_succ_self ((n - 1) * m)
  have source_step_4 :
      IsLeast { k : ℕ | 0 < k ∧
        ∀ c : ℕ → Bool,
          (∃ x : Fin m → ℕ,
            (∀ i : Fin m, 1 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ k ∧ c (x i) = true) ∧
            (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin m => i.val < m - 1)).sum (fun i => x i) <
              x ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩)
          ∨ (∃ y : Fin n → ℕ,
            (∀ i : Fin n, 1 ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ k ∧ c (y i) = false) ∧
            (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => i.val < n - 1)).sum (fun i => y i) <
              y ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩) } K := by
    constructor
    · constructor
      · exact hK_pos
      · intro c
        rcases source_step_1 c with hc1 | hc1
        · exact source_step_2 c hc1
        · exact source_step_3 c hc1
    · intro k hk
      by_contra hnot
      have hklt : k < K := by omega
      have hk_le : k ≤ (m - 1) * n := by
        dsimp [K] at hklt
        omega
      have hbad := source_step_0
      have hprop := hk.2 c0
      rcases hprop with ⟨x, hx, hxlt⟩ | ⟨y, hy, hylt⟩
      · apply hbad
        left
        refine ⟨x, ?_, hxlt⟩
        intro i
        have hxi := hx i
        exact ⟨hxi.1, le_trans hxi.2.1 hk_le, hxi.2.2⟩
      · apply hbad
        right
        refine ⟨y, ?_, hylt⟩
        intro i
        have hyi := hy i
        exact ⟨hyi.1, le_trans hyi.2.1 hk_le, hyi.2.2⟩
  simpa [K] using source_step_4

sourceSteps.sourceExcerpt: 第一步，记 K=(m−1)n+1。先证 k=K−1 不够。将 1,2,…,n−1 全部染为蓝色，将 n,n+1,…,(m−1)n 全部染为红色。任何 m 个红数的前 m−1 项各不小于 n，故其和至少为 (m−1)n，而末项至多为 (m−1)n，因此不能严格小于末项。任何 n 个蓝数的前 n−1 项都是正整数，故其和至少为 n−1，而末项至多为 n−1，也不能满足严格不等式。所以该染色不符合题设性质，故最小可行 k 至少是 K。
第二步，现对 1,…,K 的任意红蓝染色证明题设性质。按整数 1 的颜色分情况。
第三步，若 1 为蓝色：只要存在一个蓝数 b≥n，就取 n−1 个蓝数 1 与最后一个蓝数 b，得到 1+⋯+1=n−1<b，立即满足蓝色条件。因此若蓝色条件不成立，那么所有 n,n+1,…,K 必须都是红色。此时 n 和 K 都为红色，取前 m−1 个红数都等于 n，末项取 K=(m−1)n+1，则前 m−1 项之和为 (m−1)n<K，满足红色条件。故不论如何，必有一色满足。
第四步，若 1 为红色：只要存在一个红数 a≥m，就取 m−1 个红数 1 与末项 a，得到 m−1<a，满足红色条件。反之若红色条件不成立，则 m,m+1,…,K 必须都是蓝色。由于 m≥n，整数 T=(n−1)m+1 满足 m<T≤K，其中 T≤K 等价于 (n−1)m≤(m−1)n，即 n≤m。取前 n−1 个蓝数都等于 m，末项取蓝数 T，得到 (n−1)m<T，满足蓝色条件。
第五步，两种情形穷尽整数 1 的所有可能颜色，故每个对 1,…,K 的染色都满足要求。结合第一步的反例，可行的最小正整数恰为 k=(m−1)n+1。证明完毕。

goalExcerpt: 求具有下述性质的最小正整数 k：无论将 1,2,…,k 中的每个数任意染成红色或蓝色，或者存在 m 个红色的数 x₁,…,x_m（允许相同），满足 x₁+x₂+⋯+x_{m−1}<x_m；或者存在 n 个蓝色的数 y₁,…,y_n（允许相同），满足 y₁+y₂+⋯+y_{n−1}<y_n。
originalGivenExcerpts: 设 m,n 是给定的整数，m≥n≥3。

issues.originalExcerpt: 第五步，两种情形穷尽整数 1 的所有可能颜色，故每个对 1,…,K 的染色都满足要求。结合第一步的反例，可行的最小正整数恰为 k=(m−1)n+1。证明完毕。
issues.leanEvidenceExcerpt:
· intro k hk
      by_contra hnot
      have hklt : k < K := by omega
      have hk_le : k ≤ (m - 1) * n := by
issues.explanation: 原文只说结合第一步 K−1 的反例即得最小正整数为 K；但要排除所有 k<K，需额外说明该性质关于 k 的单调性，或把任意 k<K 的见证提升到 K−1 的上界范围。Lean 在 source_step_4 的最小性证明中显式引入任意 k、假设 k<K，得到 k≤(m−1)n，并用 source_step_0 反证，补上了这一未明写的步骤。未发现以大定理替换，但此处是源证明的表述缺口。

auxiliaryAssertions: have hm_ge3 : 3 ≤ m := le_trans hn hmn
have hfilter : (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin N => i.val < N - 1)) = Finset.univ.erase last := by
